boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Cornell University
boards.description: A guide to the essential late-night food stops and study sanctuaries that define the after-hours experience for Cornell students in Ithaca.

cards.title: Louie's Lunch
cards.subtitle: North Campus Food Truck
cards.notes: Visit this historic food truck parked near Risley Hall for late-night subs, burgers, and milkshakes. It has served the Cornell community since 1918.
cards.short_summary: A landmark food truck on North Campus serving hot sandwiches and shakes until 3:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Louie's Lunch is open Monday through Saturday from 5:00 PM to 3:00 AM.
cards.source_title: About — Louie's Lunch
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM Monday-Saturday; closed Sundays.

cards.title: Nasties (Bear Necessities)
cards.subtitle: Robert Purcell Community Center
cards.notes: Head to the RPCC for the 'Nasties' grill, a North Campus staple for late-night mozzarella sticks and breakfast sandwiches using Big Red Bucks.
cards.short_summary: The primary late-night dining and convenience hub for students living on North Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Bear Necessities in Robert Purcell Community Center is open until 2:00 AM during academic sessions.
cards.source_title: Commencement Weekend Dining 2026 | Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Standard academic hours typically extend to 2:00 AM daily.

cards.title: D.P. Dough
cards.subtitle: Collegetown Calzones
cards.notes: Order a custom calzone at this Collegetown favorite, known for staying open well past midnight for delivery or pickup on College Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night calzone specialist located in the heart of Collegetown.
cards.evidence_claim: D.P. Dough at 408 College Ave has online ordering hours until 3:50 AM.
cards.source_title: D.P. Dough 408 College Ave - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for late-night orders until 3:50 AM daily.

cards.title: Shortstop Deli
cards.subtitle: Home of the Hot Truck
cards.notes: Visit this downtown deli to try the legendary Hot Truck pizza subs, a Cornell tradition moved from its original truck to this 24/7-style location.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Ithaca deli serving the famous Hot Truck French-bread pizza subs.
cards.evidence_claim: Shortstop Deli is open until 10:00 PM daily and serves authentic Hot Truck pizza subs.
cards.source_title: The Legendary Hot Truck - Ithaca - Shortstop Deli
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM daily; formerly 24 hours.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sweets
cards.notes: Stop by for warm cookies and milk in Collegetown. This spot is a go-to for students pulling all-nighters or looking for a midnight dessert.
cards.short_summary: A bakery in Collegetown specializing in warm cookie delivery until the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies in Ithaca offers delivery and pickup until 3:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies | Warm Cookie Delivery
cards.access_notes: Open for delivery and pickup until 3:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Carpenter Hall Reading Room
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Engineering Study Space
cards.notes: Access this quiet study space on the Engineering Quad any time of night using your Cornell ID card. It features computers and group study areas.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study facility for Cornell students located within the Engineering Library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The first-floor main reading room in Carpenter Hall is open to Cornell students via ID card 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.source_title: Study Space - Engineering Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access for current Cornell students with ID card.

cards.title: Clark Hall Study Space
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Science Quad Study
cards.notes: Utilize the second-floor study space in Clark Hall for late-night sessions. It remains accessible whenever the building is open, typically 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-hour quiet study area located on the second floor of Clark Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Clark Physical Sciences Library study space is available 24/7 on the second floor of Clark Hall.
cards.source_title: Study Space - Clark Physical Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: Study space is open 24/7 most days of the year.

cards.title: Jack's Grill
cards.subtitle: Stewart Avenue Burgers
cards.notes: Order burgers, wings, and fries from this Stewart Avenue spot. It is a frequent choice for late-night delivery among students in West Campus and Collegetown.
cards.short_summary: A late-night grill on Stewart Avenue offering a variety of burgers and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack's Grill at 310 Stewart Ave has online ordering hours until 12:40 AM.
cards.source_title: Jack's Grill 310 Stewart Ave - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for orders until 12:40 AM daily.

cards.title: Luna Inspired Street Food
cards.subtitle: Global Late-Night Eats
cards.notes: Try tacos, bao buns, or poutine at this Stewart Avenue location. It offers a diverse menu of street food favorites available for late-night pickup.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual restaurant serving global street food with late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Luna Inspired Street Food at 310 Stewart Ave is open for online ordering until 12:30 AM.
cards.source_title: Luna Inspired Street Food - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for orders until 12:30 AM daily.

cards.title: Duffield Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Social Study Hub
cards.notes: Gather in the spacious atrium of Duffield Hall for late-night group projects. The glass-walled space is a central hub for engineering students at all hours.
cards.short_summary: A large, modern atrium on the Engineering Quad that serves as a 24-hour study and social space.
cards.evidence_claim: The atrium of Duffield Hall is open 24/7 for student use.
cards.source_title: Duffield Hall Space and Reservation System
cards.access_notes: Atrium is open 24/7; individual seminar rooms require reservations.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific campus spaces Cornell students use for late-night study, quiet focus, and collaborative work beyond the standard tour stops.

cards.title: The 24/7 Slope-Side Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Access this renovated space 24/7 with your Cornell ID for panoramic views of Libe Slope and comfortable lounge seating for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study lounge in Uris Library known for its western views and late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cocktail Lounge in Uris Library is available for quiet and group study 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with a current Cornell ID card for after-hours access.
cards.source_title: Spaces in Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; Cornell ID required for entry after standard building hours.

cards.title: Quiet Basement Focus Zone
cards.subtitle: Olin Library
cards.notes: Head to the Olin basement for a silent environment with comfortable couches and large tables, ideal for deep focus away from main floor traffic.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, lower-level study area in Olin Library favored for its silent atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin Lower Level Commons is listed as an open study space available to all library patrons without a reservation.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces - Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open during Olin Library standard hours; typically closes at 9:00 PM or later during semesters.

cards.title: Ag Quad's All-Night Anchor
cards.subtitle: Mann Library
cards.notes: Use your ID card to access the Mann lobby and Room 103 at any hour for collaborative work and computer access on the Ag Quad.
cards.short_summary: The lobby and select rooms of Mann Library are accessible 24/7 for student study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mann Library lobby, Room 112, and Mann 103 are open 24/7 to members of the Cornell community via card swipe access.
cards.source_title: Find a Space - Mann Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Lobby and Room 103 open 24/7 via Cornell ID card swipe.

cards.title: Engineering's Social Engine
cards.subtitle: Duffield Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this high-ceilinged atrium for group projects or casual study; it remains open 24/7 and features a cafe for daytime breaks.
cards.short_summary: A large, 24-hour atrium in the Engineering Quad used for collaborative study and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Duffield Hall atrium is open 24/7 and provides a space where faculty and students can interact in a relaxed environment.
cards.source_title: Duffield Hall Space and Reservation System - Cornell Engineering
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 to the Cornell community.

cards.title: Victorian Gothic Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Sage Hall
cards.notes: Study under the glass ceiling of this historic atrium during public hours; it offers a mix of high-top tables and cozy seating near the cafe.
cards.short_summary: A soaring, glass-ceilinged atrium in Sage Hall used as a community hub and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Sage Hall features a soaring atrium that serves as a hub for the community, with standard public hours from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays.
cards.source_title: Sage Hall - Johnson School Facilities | Johnson at Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Public hours: Mon-Fri 7 AM - 8 PM, Sat-Sun 7 AM - 5 PM.

cards.title: The Glass-Walled Science Hub
cards.subtitle: Physical Sciences Building
cards.notes: Utilize the floor-to-ceiling glass walls as writing surfaces for brainstorming in this modern, sunlit space connecting Clark and Baker Labs.
cards.short_summary: A modern 6,700-square-foot atrium designed for interdisciplinary collaboration and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Physical Sciences Building (PSB) contains an atrium connecting it to Clark Hall and Baker Lab, featuring glass walls that offer writing surfaces.
cards.source_title: About the Physical Sciences Building - Research & Innovation Facilities Services
cards.access_notes: Generally open 24/7 for students; some areas may require card access after hours.

cards.title: The Silent 'Harry Potter' Room
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Experience absolute silence in this three-story Victorian library; it is strictly for quiet study and houses historic book collections.
cards.short_summary: A historic, multi-tier library within Uris Library dedicated to silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: The A.D. White Library in Uris Library offers comfortable seating in a 19th-century interior and is designated as a silent study space.
cards.source_title: AD White Library - Cornell University Library
cards.access_notes: Open during Uris Library building hours; strictly silent.

cards.title: Rustic Retreat for Grads
cards.subtitle: Big Red Barn
cards.notes: Climb to the mezzanine for a cozy study spot with lounge furniture overlooking the main hall of this 1870s carriage house.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs lounge area in the Big Red Barn used for small group gatherings and leisurely study.
cards.evidence_claim: The upstairs mezzanine of the Big Red Barn has lounge furniture for small group gatherings and leisurely study.
cards.source_title: Big Red Barn - Graduate School
cards.access_notes: Building hours: Mon-Thu 8 AM - 10 PM, Fri 8 AM - 4 PM; primarily serves graduate students.

cards.title: The Student Union Living Room
cards.subtitle: Willard Straight Hall
cards.notes: Find a comfortable armchair in Room 404 to study or socialize in a warm, wood-paneled environment at the heart of campus.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, informal study and social space located on the 4th floor of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Browsing Library (room 404) in Willard Straight Hall is a comfortable place to study, have a snack, and socialize.
cards.source_title: Willard Straight Hall Student Union - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7:00 AM - 11:00 PM during the academic semester.

cards.title: The Tech-Forward Commons
cards.subtitle: Gates Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the open study areas and meeting rooms in this modern computing hub, featuring integrated technology and collaborative layouts.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art building hub for computing and information science with open study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Gates Hall offers a variety of meeting rooms and event spaces suitable for group work, with Room G01 open during building hours.
cards.source_title: Bowers Spaces - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM weekdays and 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM weekends.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Cornell University's campus without spending a dime. From world-class art and botanical gardens to historic library tours and sunset traditions, these activities are free for students and the public.

cards.title: Stroll Through the Botanic Gardens
cards.subtitle: 12 Plantations Road
cards.notes: Explore 35 acres of themed gardens and the 150-acre arboretum. It is open daily from dawn to dusk with no admission fee for students or the public.
cards.short_summary: A sprawling collection of gardens and an arboretum offering free year-round access to diverse plant life.
cards.evidence_claim: All of our gardens and natural areas are free and open to the public seven days per week year-round.
cards.source_title: Visitor FAQ | Cornell Botanic Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk. Parking is free on weekends.

cards.entity_name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.title: View Art at the Johnson Museum
cards.subtitle: 114 Central Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this I.M. Pei-designed building to see over 40,000 works of art. Admission is always free for everyone, and the top floor offers panoramic views.
cards.short_summary: A prominent university art museum featuring global collections and iconic architecture with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission for everyone is always free.
cards.source_title: Visit - Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 10AM–5PM. Closed Mondays.

cards.title: Listen to a Chimes Concert
cards.subtitle: McGraw Tower
cards.notes: Climb 161 steps to watch chimesmasters play the 21-bell instrument. Daily concerts are free and open to the public; check the schedule online.
cards.short_summary: Daily live bell concerts played by students in the historic McGraw Tower, accessible for free.
cards.evidence_claim: Chimemasters play daily concerts that the public is welcome to attend. Reservations are not required.
cards.source_title: Policies | Cornell Chimes
cards.access_notes: Check the online schedule for daily concert times, typically morning, midday, and evening.

cards.title: Watch the Sunset on Libe Slope
cards.subtitle: Libe Slope
cards.notes: Join a long-standing Cornell tradition by gathering on the grassy hill below Uris Library to watch the sun set over Cayuga Lake.
cards.short_summary: A popular campus tradition where students gather on a scenic hillside for sunset views.
cards.evidence_claim: Watching sunsets on Libe Slope is a beloved tradition for generations of Cornellians.
cards.source_title: Libe Slope, Friends, and East Hill Sunsets - Cornell Alumni
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible 24/7; best visited at dusk.

cards.title: Tour the A.D. White Library
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Step into the 'Harry Potter' style library inside Uris. It features three stories of ornate metal stacks and is free to enter for quiet study or viewing.
cards.short_summary: A historic, visually stunning library space within Uris Library open for public viewing and quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The A.D. White Library is a large, three-story room within Uris Library... Cost: Free.
cards.source_title: AD White Library | Cornell University Library
cards.access_notes: Open during Uris Library hours; typically 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Hike the Beebe Lake Loop
cards.subtitle: Beebe Lake
cards.notes: Walk the one-mile loop trail around Beebe Lake. This natural area is located in the heart of campus and offers free access for hiking and birdwatching.
cards.short_summary: A scenic one-mile trail circling Beebe Lake, providing a natural escape on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors can explore Cornell Botanic Gardens Beebe Lake Natural Area on the one-mile loop trail... open year-round.
cards.source_title: Beebe Lake Natural Area - Ithaca Trails
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Birdwatch at Sapsucker Woods
cards.subtitle: 159 Sapsucker Woods Road
cards.notes: Visit the Cornell Lab of Ornithology's 220-acre sanctuary. Admission to the visitor center and the four miles of trails is free for all visitors.
cards.short_summary: A world-renowned bird sanctuary with free trails and an educational visitor center.
cards.evidence_claim: The facility features a variety of exhibits about the science of birds and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit the Cornell Lab - Cornell Lab of Ornithology
cards.access_notes: Trails open daily dawn to dusk; Visitor Center open Tuesday-Sunday 10AM-4PM.

cards.title: Watch Ice Cream Being Made
cards.subtitle: Stocking Hall
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of Stocking Hall to look through glass windows at the Cornell Dairy plant. It's free to watch the production process.
cards.short_summary: A public observation deck overlooking Cornell's active dairy processing plant.
cards.evidence_claim: From an observational balcony above the Dairy Plant, visitors have a bird's-eye view of milk... being transformed into ice cream.
cards.source_title: Stocking Hall Reservations - Cornell CALS
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours, typically weekdays 8AM-5PM.

cards.title: Attend Midday Music at Sage
cards.subtitle: Sage Chapel
cards.notes: Enjoy free organ recitals and musical performances in this historic non-denominational chapel. Most Department of Music concerts here are free.
cards.short_summary: A series of free musical performances held in the university's historic Gothic-style chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Midday Music for Organ... Free and open to the public, no tickets required.
cards.source_title: Sage Chapel - Cornell Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Check the Cornell Events calendar for specific concert dates and times.

cards.title: Walk the Cascadilla Gorge
cards.subtitle: Cascadilla Creek
cards.notes: Hike the trail connecting downtown Ithaca to the Cornell campus. It features multiple waterfalls and is free to the public during the open season.
cards.short_summary: A scenic gorge trail featuring multiple waterfalls, connecting the city to the university campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cascadilla Gorge Trail is now open for the season... free of charge.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Natural Areas | Cornell Botanic Gardens
cards.access_notes: Seasonal access; typically open late spring through late fall. Closed in winter.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: A.D. White Library
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Study in a three-story Victorian Gothic reading room featuring ornate iron stacks and quiet carrels. This space is designated for silent study only.
cards.short_summary: A historic, multi-tiered silent reading room located within Uris Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The A.D. White Library is a historic interior in Uris Library designated as a silent study space.
cards.source_title: Spaces in Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard Uris Library hours; accessible to all Cornell students.

cards.title: Uris Library Cocktail Lounge
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Access this 24/7 study space featuring panoramic views of Libe Slope. Use your Cornell ID for entry after standard building hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study lounge with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Libe Slope.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cocktail Lounge in Uris Library is available for quiet and group study 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with a Cornell ID.
cards.source_title: Spaces in Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; Cornell ID card required for access after building hours.

cards.title: Mui Ho Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: Rand Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the suspended stacks and open-concept reading rooms in this rehabilitated industrial space. The top two floors offer voluminous natural light.
cards.short_summary: A modern library in Rand Hall featuring four levels of suspended book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mui Ho Fine Arts Library occupies the top two floors of Rand Hall and provides voluminous reading and study space.
cards.source_title: New Mui Ho Fine Arts Library inspires design - Cornell Chronicle
cards.access_notes: Open to the Cornell community during posted library hours.

cards.title: Clark Physical Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Clark Hall
cards.notes: Find quiet cubicles and 24/7 study access on the second floor of Clark Hall. The space is located directly above the Clark Atrium.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study area located in Room 290 of Clark Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Clark Hall Library Study Space is available 24/7 on the second floor of Clark Hall in room 290.
cards.source_title: Study Space - Clark Physical Sciences Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Study space is open 24/7 whenever Clark Hall is open.

cards.title: Bissett Collaborative Space
cards.subtitle: Mann Library
cards.notes: Use this first-floor area for group work and collaborative projects. It features flexible seating and proximity to the library's main services.
cards.short_summary: A designated collaborative study area on the first floor of Mann Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bissett Collaborative Space is a featured study area in Mann Library suitable for group work.
cards.source_title: Find a Space - Mann Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open during Mann Library hours; some sections are reservable.

cards.title: Management Library
cards.subtitle: Sage Hall
cards.notes: Study in the heart of Central Campus with a variety of seating from high bar-style chairs to individual desks with lamps and outlets.
cards.short_summary: A cozy library space located within the historic Sage Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Management Library in Sage Hall offers a variety of seating options including desks with lamps and outlets.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Study Spots on Campus | Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Public hours are M-F 7am-8pm; after-hours access restricted to Johnson School students.

cards.title: Kroch Asia Library
cards.subtitle: Olin Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level for a secluded environment. This underground space is known for its quiet atmosphere and individual study carrels.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, subterranean study space located beneath Olin Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kroch Asia Library offers open study spaces and is noted for its quiet environment on the lower levels.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces - Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Accessible through Olin Library during standard operating hours.

cards.title: Browsing Library
cards.subtitle: Willard Straight Hall
cards.notes: Relax in the 'living room' of campus. This comfortable lounge on the 4th floor is suitable for casual studying and socializing.
cards.short_summary: A casual study lounge located on the 4th floor of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Browsing Library (room 404) in Willard Straight Hall is a comfortable place to study and socialize.
cards.source_title: Willard Straight Hall Student Union - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. during the academic semester.

cards.title: Klarman Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Klarman Hall
cards.notes: Study in a bright, light-filled atrium that connects to Goldwin Smith Hall. The space includes the Temple of Zeus cafe for nearby refreshments.
cards.short_summary: A large, sunlit atrium serving as a central meeting and study hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Klarman Hall features a light-filled atrium that serves as a meeting place for faculty and students.
cards.source_title: Temple of Zeus - College of Arts & Sciences, Cornell
cards.access_notes: The building is generally open to the public during daytime hours.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Hall
cards.notes: Enjoy a traditional library setting with revolving chairs and ample natural light. This space is typically quieter than the main central libraries.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library in Lincoln Hall specializing in music and dance collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library in Lincoln Hall is a traditional library setting with quiet study areas and natural light.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Study Spots on Campus | Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Open during posted Music Library hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential streets and corridors surrounding Cornell University, from the high-energy hubs of Collegetown to the historic pedestrian paths of downtown Ithaca.

cards.title: The Heart of Collegetown
cards.subtitle: Collegetown Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this central artery to find student staples like Collegetown Bagels and the Schwartz Center for the Performing Arts.
cards.short_summary: College Avenue is the primary commercial spine of Collegetown, serving as the main social and transit hub for Cornell students.
cards.evidence_claim: College Avenue is described as the epicenter of off-campus student life, packed with apartment buildings, restaurants, and late-night food spots.
cards.source_title: Ithaca Collegetown | Off-Campus Restaurants & Shopping
cards.access_notes: Public street with high foot traffic; most businesses open daily from morning until late night.

cards.title: The Dining Hub
cards.subtitle: Collegetown Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this block for a high density of international eateries and the primary parking garage for the Collegetown district.
cards.short_summary: Dryden Road intersects College Avenue and is known for its diverse culinary options and dense student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Dryden Road is highlighted as a key part of Collegetown with a variety of culturally diverse menus and the Dryden Road parking garage.
cards.source_title: Ithaca Collegetown | Off-Campus Restaurants & Shopping
cards.access_notes: Public street; parking garage available for a fee, but walking the corridor is free.

cards.title: The Historic Gateway
cards.subtitle: Collegetown Corridor
cards.notes: Enter campus through the historic Eddy Gate at the top of this steep hill, which once served as the university's main entrance.
cards.short_summary: Eddy Street is a historic corridor featuring the original stone entrance to Cornell and long-standing local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Eddy Gate, built in 1896 at the top of Eddy Street, is the original main entrance to Cornell University and features the school's motto.
cards.source_title: Collegetown 101: How Ezra's University Shaped a Neighborhood
cards.access_notes: Public street; the steep incline makes it a popular but strenuous walking route to campus.

cards.title: The Gorge-Side Corridor
cards.subtitle: East Hill District
cards.notes: Walk along the edge of Cascadilla Gorge to see unique architecture, including the former residence of Carl Sagan.
cards.short_summary: Stewart Avenue runs parallel to the campus gorges, offering scenic views and historic residential landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: 900 Stewart Avenue is a landmark building noted for its Egyptian Revival architecture and for being the residence of astronomer Carl Sagan.
cards.source_title: Riddle of the Sphinx: Carl Sagan's former home remains an intriguing local landmark
cards.access_notes: Public street; the Sagan house is a private residence visible from the sidewalk and the opposite side of the gorge.

cards.title: The Pedestrian Spine
cards.subtitle: Downtown Ithaca
cards.notes: Explore this four-block pedestrian mall for independent bookstores, local boutiques, and the Sagan Planet Walk.
cards.short_summary: The Commons is Ithaca's award-winning pedestrian district and the cultural center of the downtown area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons is a four-block pedestrian district serving as a daily hub for students and locals with independently owned shops and public art.
cards.source_title: The Commons - Downtown Ithaca Alliance
cards.access_notes: Pedestrian-only zone; open 24/7, though individual business hours vary.

cards.title: The Historic Hill Climb
cards.subtitle: DeWitt Park to East Hill
cards.notes: Climb this steep street to see historic mansions and Buffalo Street Books, a community-owned cooperative bookstore.
cards.short_summary: East Buffalo Street connects downtown Ithaca to the Cornell campus, passing through the historic DeWitt Park area.
cards.evidence_claim: East Buffalo Street is home to Buffalo Street Books and serves as a strenuous walking route that ascends from DeWitt Park toward the hill.
cards.source_title: The Commons - Downtown Ithaca Alliance
cards.access_notes: Public street; very steep incline between downtown and the university.

cards.title: The East Hill Plaza Hub
cards.subtitle: East Hill District
cards.notes: Head here for essential services like the P&C Fresh grocery store and various Cornell administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: Pine Tree Road is the primary commercial corridor for the East Hill area, located just east of the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: East Hill Plaza on Pine Tree Road is a convenient suburban shopping center near Cornell with a grocery, pharmacy, and laundry services.
cards.source_title: East Hill Plaza - Visit Ithaca
cards.access_notes: Public road and shopping center; accessible via TCAT bus route 82.

cards.title: The Gorge Trail Access
cards.subtitle: Cascadilla Gorge Corridor
cards.notes: Access the lower entrance of the Cascadilla Gorge Trail, which features eight waterfalls along a stone-stepped path.
cards.short_summary: This road borders the Cascadilla Gorge and provides a scenic pedestrian link between downtown and Collegetown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cascadilla Gorge Trail creates a direct connection between Cornell University and downtown Ithaca, following the creek through waterfalls.
cards.source_title: Cascadilla Hall | Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Public road; trail access is seasonal and typically closed during winter months for safety.

cards.title: The Student Residential Block
cards.subtitle: Collegetown Housing
cards.notes: Observe the high-density modern student housing developments that characterize the recent growth of Collegetown.
cards.short_summary: Catherine Street is a dense residential block in Collegetown known for its proximity to campus and large apartment complexes.
cards.evidence_claim: Catherine Commons and other large apartment buildings on Catherine Street offer student-focused living in the heart of Collegetown.
cards.source_title: Catherine Commons | Student Apartments Near Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; primarily used by students walking to the nearby Engineering Quad.

cards.title: The West End Gateway
cards.subtitle: West End District
cards.notes: Visit the West End for a more local feel, featuring the Kitchen Theatre Company and the original Gimme! Coffee location.
cards.short_summary: West State Street is the main thoroughfare of Ithaca's West End, offering a mix of local businesses and cultural venues.
cards.evidence_claim: The West End, centered along State Street, is home to the Kitchen Theatre and local favorites like Gimme! Coffee, offering a genuine local flavor.
cards.source_title: Ithaca – West End Apartments - CSP Management
cards.access_notes: Public street; located about a 20-minute walk or short bus ride from the downtown Commons.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From a massive architecture-built dragon to throwing fish at hockey rivals, Cornell's traditions are as eccentric as they are enduring.

cards.title: Dragon Day
cards.subtitle: A Century of Architecture vs. Engineering
cards.notes: Watch first-year architecture students parade a massive dragon to the Arts Quad to battle a phoenix built by engineering rivals.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring parade featuring a student-built dragon and a mock battle with a phoenix on the Arts Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Dragon Day is a tradition dating back to 1901 where architecture students build a dragon to parade across campus in March.
cards.source_title: Dragon Day '24: Snapshots from a Serpentine Celebration
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Friday before Spring Break; the parade route typically ends at the Arts Quad.

cards.title: Slope Day
cards.subtitle: The Ultimate End-of-Classes Celebration
cards.notes: Join thousands of students on Libe Slope for live music and food to celebrate the final day of undergraduate classes.
cards.short_summary: A massive year-end celebration on Libe Slope featuring major musical acts and community festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Slope Day is Cornell's largest annual outdoor student gathering, held on the day after the last day of classes in May.
cards.source_title: History - Slope Day Programming Board
cards.access_notes: Access to the main slope area requires a Cornell ID and a pre-purchased wristband for security purposes.

cards.title: Chimes Concerts
cards.subtitle: The Heartbeat of McGraw Tower
cards.notes: Climb 161 steps to the top of McGraw Tower to watch Chimesmasters perform live concerts three times daily.
cards.short_summary: Daily 15-minute bell concerts played by student Chimesmasters from the iconic McGraw Tower.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Chimes have played regular concerts since 1868, with three 15-minute performances scheduled daily.
cards.source_title: About the Cornell Chimes
cards.access_notes: McGraw Tower is open to visitors during scheduled concert times; check the official website for daily hours.

cards.title: The Fish Fling
cards.subtitle: A Cold Welcome for Harvard
cards.notes: Experience the rowdy tradition of fans throwing fish onto the ice when the Harvard hockey team visits Lynah Rink.
cards.short_summary: A decades-old hockey tradition where Cornell fans throw fish at the opposing Harvard team.
cards.evidence_claim: The tradition of throwing fish onto the ice during Harvard games at Lynah Rink has been in place since the early 1970s.
cards.source_title: Inside the Fish-Throwing Tradition at Lynah Rink
cards.access_notes: Occurs specifically during the annual home game against Harvard; tickets are highly competitive.

cards.title: The Hot Truck PMP
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Poor Man's Pizza
cards.notes: Order a 'PMP' (Poor Man's Pizza) at Shortstop Deli to taste the French bread sub that fueled Cornellians for 50 years.
cards.short_summary: A legendary late-night food tradition featuring French bread pizza subs originally served from a truck on Stewart Ave.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hot Truck, founded by Bob Petrillose in 1960, is a Cornell institution known for its PMP pizza subs.
cards.source_title: Hot Truck, Warm Memories: Pizza Subs Were a Big Red Institution
cards.access_notes: The original truck is retired, but the menu is served 24/7 at Shortstop Deli in downtown Ithaca.

cards.title: Dairy Bar Ice Cream
cards.subtitle: Fresh from the Vet College Cows
cards.notes: Sample premium ice cream made on-site using milk from the university's own dairy cows just half a mile away.
cards.short_summary: A campus creamery serving ice cream made with milk from Cornell's teaching dairy barn.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Dairy Bar serves ice cream produced at the on-campus processing plant using milk from the Vet College barn.
cards.source_title: Cornell Dairy Bar | CALS
cards.access_notes: Located in Stocking Hall; open to the public during daytime hours on weekdays and select weekends.

cards.title: Fireworks & Laser Show
cards.subtitle: Schoellkopf Field Spectacle
cards.notes: Gather at Schoellkopf Field for a massive Friday night display of fireworks and lasers to kick off Homecoming weekend.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy nighttime show at the football stadium featuring pyrotechnics and laser lights.
cards.evidence_claim: The Homecoming Fireworks and Laser Light Show is a free annual event held at Schoellkopf Field.
cards.source_title: Homecoming - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; typically held on the Friday evening of Homecoming weekend.

cards.title: Touchdown the Bear
cards.subtitle: The Unofficial Mascot
cards.notes: Visit the bronze statue of Touchdown outside Teagle Hall, commemorating the live bears that once prowled the sidelines.
cards.short_summary: The unofficial bear mascot of Cornell, represented by a bronze statue and a student-run mascot program.
cards.evidence_claim: Touchdown became the unofficial mascot in 1915 when a live bear cub was brought to football games.
cards.source_title: About Us - BIG RED BEARS
cards.access_notes: The statue is located outdoors near the entrance of Teagle Hall and is accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Christmas Vespers
cards.subtitle: Lessons and Carols in Sage Chapel
cards.notes: Attend this candlelit service featuring the Cornell Chorus and Glee Club for a traditional holiday experience.
cards.short_summary: An annual holiday service of lessons and carols held in the historic Sage Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Sage Chapel Christmas Vespers is an annual tradition featuring the Cornell Chorus and Glee Club.
cards.source_title: Lessons and carols in Sage Chapel Dec. 3 and 4
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; held in early December. Seating is first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Spirit of Zinck's Night
cards.subtitle: A Global Alumni Toast
cards.notes: Celebrate the memory of Ithaca saloon owner Theodore Zinck during this worldwide night of Cornellian camaraderie.
cards.short_summary: An international night of celebration for Cornellians, named after a famous 19th-century Ithaca barkeep.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spirit of Zinck's Night is an annual event held on the third Thursday of October to honor Theodore Zinck.
cards.source_title: The history behind the International Spirit of Zinck's Night
cards.access_notes: Events are held globally; while many are in venues serving alcohol, the tradition itself is a community social event.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Cornell University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A curated sequence of essential Cornell experiences for new students, from sunset views on Libe Slope to the iconic flavors of the Dairy Bar.

cards.title: Kick Off Your Cornell Journey
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide
cards.notes: Begin your first weekend with New Student Orientation (NSO) events. Meet your Orientation Leader and small group to navigate campus resources and build early connections.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome program for all incoming first-year and transfer students.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Orientation (NSO) for 2026 is scheduled for August 18–23, featuring required small group meetings and social activities.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; schedules are provided via the Cornell orientation portal.

cards.title: Watch the Sunset on the Slope
cards.subtitle: Between Uris Library and West Campus
cards.notes: Join fellow students on the grassy hill for a quintessential Ithaca sunset. Bring a blanket and enjoy the panoramic views of West Campus and the city below.
cards.short_summary: A beloved campus tradition where students gather nightly to watch the sun set over the valley.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunsets on Libe Slope are a long-standing campus tradition, especially popular when students first arrive in August.
cards.source_title: Uniquely Cornell: Four Activities to do in Four Seasons
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; best visited during the hour before sunset.

cards.title: Taste Official Cornell Ice Cream
cards.subtitle: Stocking Hall
cards.notes: Visit the east end of campus for a scoop of premium ice cream made on-site. Try signature flavors like 'Bavarian Raspberry Fudge' or 'Big Red Bear Tracks.'
cards.short_summary: The university's famous dairy shop serving ice cream, milk, and yogurt produced by the Department of Food Science.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Dairy Bar is located in Stocking Hall and serves ice cream, sundaes, and floats made from Cornell Dairy products.
cards.source_title: Cornell Dairy Bar | CALS
cards.access_notes: Check seasonal hours; typically open weekdays 8:30 AM - 6:00 PM during the fall semester.

cards.title: Listen to the McGraw Tower Chimes
cards.subtitle: Ho Plaza
cards.notes: Pause at the center of campus to hear the 21-bell chime. Concerts often include a mix of the Alma Mater, classical pieces, and modern pop requests.
cards.short_summary: Daily musical performances played by student Chimesmasters from the top of McGraw Tower.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Chimes are performed from McGraw Tower three times a day during the school year.
cards.source_title: Concert Schedule | Cornell Chimes
cards.access_notes: Concerts are audible from the Arts Quad and Ho Plaza; tower climbs may be restricted during orientation.

cards.title: Walk the Beebe Lake Loop
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Take a relaxing one-mile walk around the lake. It's a perfect escape into nature located just steps away from the first-year residence halls on North Campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic natural area featuring a wooded trail, wetlands, and views of Fall Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beebe Lake Natural Area features a one-mile loop trail popular for hiking and jogging.
cards.source_title: Beebe Lake and Woods | Cornell Botanic Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; trails are mostly flat and easy to navigate.

cards.title: Grab Breakfast at CTB
cards.subtitle: 420 College Avenue
cards.notes: Experience a Cornell rite of passage by ordering a bagel sandwich at 'CTB.' It's the social hub of Collegetown and a favorite weekend morning destination.
cards.short_summary: An iconic local eatery and community space that has served Cornellians since 1976.
cards.evidence_claim: Collegetown Bagels (CTB) is described as a shared experience for nearly all Cornellians and a staple of student life.
cards.source_title: Inside Collegetown Bagels' Role in the Tapestry of Cornell's Culture
cards.access_notes: Open daily; expect long lines on weekend mornings during the first few weeks of school.

cards.entity_name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.title: Explore the Johnson Museum
cards.subtitle: Central Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the museum to see world-class art and head to the top floor for one of the best indoor views of campus and Cayuga Lake.
cards.short_summary: Cornell's primary art museum, known for its diverse collections and distinctive I.M. Pei-designed building.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Johnson Museum of Art is always free for everyone, and it features a rooftop with views of Central Campus.
cards.source_title: Visit - Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 10 AM – 5 PM; closed on Mondays.

cards.title: Relax in the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Ho Plaza
cards.notes: Known as the campus 'living room,' the Straight offers cozy lounges and a browsing library. It's a great spot to meet friends or find a quiet corner to read.
cards.short_summary: Cornell's historic student union building, home to student activities, dining, and a cinema.
cards.evidence_claim: Willard Straight Hall is considered the 'living room' of the campus, with lounges like the Browsing Library open to the public.
cards.source_title: Willard Straight Hall Student Union - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Building hours are typically 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM daily during the semester.

cards.title: Visit the Tatkon Center Hub
cards.subtitle: Robert Purcell Community Center
cards.notes: Stop by the 'Tat' on North Campus to meet Peer Leaders who can answer questions about your first week and help you find your way around.
cards.short_summary: A resource center specifically designed to support new students during their transition to Cornell.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tatkon Center Hub is located on the first floor of the Robert Purcell Community Center (RPCC) and is staffed by Tatkon Peer Leaders.
cards.source_title: Tatkon Center for New Students | Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Located in RPCC 101; typically open Sunday–Thursday for student support.

cards.title: Get Your Big Red Gear
cards.subtitle: Ho Plaza
cards.notes: Pick up your first Cornell t-shirt or hoodie. It's the central spot for textbooks, supplies, and all things Big Red to prepare for the start of classes.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore and merchandise center located in the heart of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Store is the primary location for university merchandise and academic supplies, located on Ho Plaza.
cards.source_title: About Us | The Cornell Store
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check website for extended orientation weekend hours.
